text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add one high-contrast skip link at the very top of every page that jumps straight to the main content. This fixes the biggest keyboard trap for screen-reader users without cluttering the page. The trade-off is one extra tab stop, but it’s worth it for the 1 in 5 users who rely on keyboard navigation.

name: Reader
text: A single high-contrast skip link may not be effective on pages with multiple distinct content sections, as it could lead to confusion for users trying to navigate to specific areas. Instead, consider adding skip links tailored to each section, which provides more precise navigation without forcing users through irrelevant content. To settle this, conduct user testing with diverse groups to determine the effectiveness of either approach in real-world scenarios.
